Refund policy checks gate on a failed goal:refunds check and are excluded from credit totals; existing fixtures keep their pass semantics.
Run-record checks schema and the e2e driver pass weight/gated through additively.
The full gate passes on the improvements branch.

outcome.summary: Weighted/gated grader contract shipped on improvements/audit-borrows: partial credit with strict pass, dependent-check gating on goal:refunds, and additive run-record pass-through — gate green.

what_worked: The contract stayed back-compatible: existing fixtures and suites pass unchanged because gating only activates on goal failures and weights default to 1.
